graph_hero_questions.text: Which large projects in delivery are forecast to overrun their approved budget by more than 10%?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.forecast + epbcs.plan + pmo.project + commitments.win_authorization at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commitments.win_authorization w
                         WHERE w.project_code = p.project_code AND w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.win_status = 'Pending')
            THEN 'Revision raised' ELSE 'No revision' END AS win_state
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.large_project = 1 AND p.phase = 'In Delivery'
  AND l.forecast_at_completion_usd > 1.10 * b.approved_budget_usd

graph_hero_questions.text: Are we on track to spend the FY26 plan by December?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.monthly_spread + gl.project_costing_line at high confidence (0.91).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.period <= 9 THEN g.posted_usd ELSE m.forecast_usd END) AS expected_fy_usd,
       SUM(m.plan_usd) AS plan_fy_usd
FROM epbcs.monthly_spread m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_code, CAST(RIGHT(fiscal_period, 2) AS INT) AS period, SUM(amount_usd) AS posted_usd
           FROM gl.project_costing_line WHERE fiscal_period LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY project_code, RIGHT(fiscal_period, 2)) g
  ON g.project_code = m.project_code AND g.period = m.period
WHERE m.fiscal_year = 2026 AND m.vintage = 'Working'

graph_hero_questions.text: Where does the program stand against its approved budget, and is it inside the 5% tolerance?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + epbcs.forecast at high confidence (0.92); the tolerance is read from the Capital Program Policy.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT f.project_code, f.forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.project_code ORDER BY f.forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast f
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd AS variance_usd,
       (l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd) / NULLIF(b.approved_budget_usd, 0) AS variance_pct
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.phase <> 'Closed'

graph_hero_questions.text: Which projects have not been re-forecast for more than 45 days?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.forecast + pmo.project at high confidence (0.95).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.region, p.cost_tool, COUNT(*) AS stale_projects, SUM(b.approved_budget_usd) AS budget_usd
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
WHERE p.phase IN ('In Development', 'In Delivery')
  AND (SELECT MAX(f.forecast_date) FROM epbcs.forecast f WHERE f.project_code = p.project_code) < DATEADD(day, -45, '2026-10-15')
GROUP BY p.region, p.cost_tool

graph_hero_questions.text: Which projects claimed in the Belmara test year are now at risk of missing it?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.rate_case_claim + upload.inservice at medium confidence (0.81): two claimed projects have no in-service row.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT r.docket, r.project_code, p.project_name, r.claimed_in_service_by, i.forecast_in_service_date, r.rate_base_usd
FROM pmo.rate_case_claim r
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = r.project_code
LEFT JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = r.project_code
WHERE r.claim_status IN ('Claimed', 'Updated')
  AND (i.forecast_in_service_date > r.test_year_end OR i.project_code IS NULL)

graph_hero_questions.text: Why is Dunmoor East Filter Media Renewal over budget?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.forecast + pmo.change_order + the project's documents + mailbox at question time at high confidence (0.88).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT o.co_number, o.reason_category, o.cost_impact_usd, o.co_status, o.approved_on
FROM pmo.change_order o
WHERE o.project_code = 'C23B225_690'
ORDER BY o.co_number

graph_hero_questions.text: How much contingency is left across the program, and where is it going?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + epbcs.forecast at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, contingency_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT b.project_code, b.contingency_usd AS contingency_at_approval_usd, l.contingency_usd AS contingency_left_usd
FROM epbcs.plan b
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = b.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026

graph_hero_questions.text: Which WIN budget revisions are waiting at Level 03, and for how long?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.win_authorization at high confidence (0.96).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT w.approval_level, COUNT(*) AS pending, SUM(w.amount_usd) AS amount_usd,
       MAX(DATEDIFF(day, w.requested_on, '2026-10-19')) AS oldest_days
FROM commitments.win_authorization w
WHERE w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.win_status = 'Pending'
GROUP BY w.approval_level

graph_hero_questions.text: How does plant placed in service compare with what the last Belmara rate order assumed?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.plant_in_service + the BPUC order excerpt at medium confidence (0.84).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS placed_in_service_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = s.project_code
WHERE s.in_service_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.utility_code

graph_hero_questions.text: What evidence do we have that the Dunmoor East cost increase was prudent?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.change_order + commitments.win_authorization + committee minutes at medium confidence (0.79).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT w.win_id, w.request_type, w.approval_level, w.amount_usd, w.win_status, w.approved_on, w.reason
FROM commitments.win_authorization w
WHERE w.project_code = 'C23B225_690'
ORDER BY w.requested_on

graph_hero_questions.text: Which projects are in service but still sitting in CWIP?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.cwip_balance + upload.inservice at high confidence (0.87).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c.project_code, c.cwip_usd, i.forecast_in_service_date
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = c.project_code
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09' AND c.cwip_usd > 0 AND i.forecast_in_service_date < '2026-08-01'

graph_hero_questions.text: Which contracts have change orders above 8% of their original value?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.contract + pmo.change_order at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c.project_code, c.contract_no, c.award_value_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.co_status = 'Approved' THEN o.cost_impact_usd ELSE 0 END) AS approved_co_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.co_status = 'Approved' THEN o.cost_impact_usd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(c.award_value_usd, 0) AS co_rate
FROM pmo.contract c
LEFT JOIN pmo.change_order o ON o.contract_no = c.contract_no
GROUP BY c.project_code, c.contract_no, c.award_value_usd

graph_hero_questions.text: How much open commitment does each utility carry into Q4?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.po_line + pmo.project at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT l.project_code, SUM(l.ordered_usd - l.received_usd - l.cancelled_usd) AS open_usd
FROM commitments.po_line l
WHERE l.line_status = 'Open'
GROUP BY l.project_code

graph_hero_questions.text: How much of the 5-year plan is driven by mandates rather than discretionary renewal?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + pmo.project at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT b.plan_vintage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.compliance_driver <> 'None' THEN b.plan_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(b.plan_amount_usd) AS mandated_share
FROM epbcs.plan b
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = b.project_code
WHERE b.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2027 AND 2031
GROUP BY b.plan_vintage

graph_hero_questions.text: How does my utility's FY26 spend compare with its plan?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across gl.project_costing_line + epbcs.monthly_spread at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(g.amount_usd) AS posted_ytd_usd,
       (SELECT SUM(m.plan_usd) FROM epbcs.monthly_spread m
        WHERE m.fiscal_year = 2026 AND m.vintage = 'Jan Calendarization' AND m.period <= 9) AS plan_ytd_usd
FROM gl.project_costing_line g
WHERE g.fiscal_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-09'

graph_hero_questions.text: What share of large projects in delivery are within 10% of their budget?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + epbcs.forecast + pmo.project at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.forecast_at_completion_usd <= 1.10 * b.approved_budget_usd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS health
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.large_project = 1 AND p.phase = 'In Delivery'

graph_hero_questions.text: Which large projects slipped on their critical path this month?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: Primavera P6 is not connected, so milestones and float cannot be read.

graph_hero_questions.text: What is Belmara's rate base at the end of the test year, and how does it compare with the last order?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.plant_in_service + assets.depreciation_reserve + assets.rate_base_component at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT s.utility_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) - SUM(d.accumulated_depreciation_usd) AS net_plant_usd
  FROM assets.plant_in_service s
  JOIN assets.depreciation_reserve d ON d.asset_id = s.asset_id AND d.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
  WHERE s.retired_on IS NULL GROUP BY s.utility_code
)
SELECT p.utility_code, p.net_plant_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.treatment = 'Deduct' THEN -c.amount_usd ELSE c.amount_usd END) AS adjustments_usd,
       p.net_plant_usd + SUM(CASE WHEN c.treatment = 'Deduct' THEN -c.amount_usd ELSE c.amount_usd END) AS rate_base_usd
FROM plant p
JOIN assets.rate_base_component c ON c.utility_code = p.utility_code AND c.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY p.utility_code, p.net_plant_usd

graph_hero_questions.text: What have we invested in plant, pipes and treatment since the last rate order, net of depreciation?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.plant_in_service + assets.depreciation_reserve at high confidence (0.89).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS additions_since_order_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.in_service_date > '2022-12-31' AND s.retired_on IS NULL
GROUP BY s.utility_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Which projects are in service but not yet unitized, and how much do they hold?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.plant_in_service at high confidence (0.94).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.project_code, COUNT(*) AS assets, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS amount_usd, MIN(s.in_service_date) AS earliest_in_service
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.unitized = 0
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.project_code

graph_hero_questions.text: What is the net plant in service by plant class for each utility?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.plant_in_service + assets.depreciation_reserve at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.plant_class, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS gross_plant_usd, SUM(d.accumulated_depreciation_usd) AS accumulated_depreciation_usd,
       SUM(s.amount_usd) - SUM(d.accumulated_depreciation_usd) AS net_plant_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
JOIN assets.depreciation_reserve d ON d.asset_id = s.asset_id AND d.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
WHERE s.retired_on IS NULL
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.plant_class

graph_hero_questions.text: How much CWIP is older than 24 months, and on which projects?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.cwip_balance at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 24 THEN 'Over 24 months' WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 12 THEN '12 to 24 months' ELSE 'Under 12 months' END AS age_band,
       SUM(c.cwip_usd) AS cwip_usd
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 24 THEN 'Over 24 months' WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 12 THEN '12 to 24 months' ELSE 'Under 12 months' END

graph_hero_questions.text: Which major additions are missing part of their prudence record?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.win_authorization + pmo.contract + pmo.change_order + committee minutes at medium confidence (0.8).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, s.amount_usd,
       MAX(CASE WHEN w.request_type = 'Original authorization' AND w.win_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_approval,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.contract_no) AS contracts, SUM(CASE WHEN o.co_status = 'Approved' THEN o.cost_impact_usd ELSE 0 END) AS approved_change_orders_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = s.project_code
LEFT JOIN commitments.win_authorization w ON w.project_code = p.project_code
LEFT JOIN pmo.contract c ON c.project_code = p.project_code
LEFT JOIN pmo.change_order o ON o.contract_no = c.contract_no
WHERE p.utility_code = 'BEL' AND s.in_service_date > '2022-12-31'
GROUP BY p.project_code, p.project_name, s.amount_usd

graph_hero_questions.text: How much depreciation did we book this year, by plant class and rate?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.depreciation_reserve at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT d.plant_class, d.depreciation_rate, SUM(d.depreciation_expense_usd) AS expense_usd
FROM assets.depreciation_reserve d
WHERE d.fiscal_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-09'
GROUP BY d.plant_class, d.depreciation_rate

graph_hero_questions.text: What share of pipe, valve and hydrant spend went through framework agreements this year?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.po_line + commitments.framework_agreement at high confidence (0.91).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT a.category,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.framework_agreement_no IS NOT NULL THEN l.ordered_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.ordered_usd) AS framework_share
FROM commitments.po_line l
JOIN commitments.framework_agreement a ON a.item_code = l.item_code
WHERE l.ordered_on >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY a.category

graph_hero_questions.text: Which order lines were placed off-framework above the framework price, and what did that cost?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.po_line + commitments.framework_agreement at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT l.po_number, l.line_no, l.project_code, l.item_code, l.quantity, l.unit_price_usd, a.framework_unit_price_usd,
       (l.unit_price_usd - a.framework_unit_price_usd) * l.quantity AS premium_usd, l.confirmation_status
FROM commitments.po_line l
JOIN commitments.framework_agreement a ON a.item_code = l.item_code
WHERE l.framework_agreement_no IS NULL AND l.unit_price_usd > a.framework_unit_price_usd

graph_hero_questions.text: How much has the procurement savings program secured against its 2.5% target?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.savings_register at high confidence (0.95).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.lever, SUM(s.savings_usd) AS secured_usd
FROM commitments.savings_register s
WHERE s.secured_on >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY s.lever

graph_hero_questions.text: What lead times are framework suppliers confirming now?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.framework_agreement + supplier mail at question time at medium confidence (0.83).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT a.framework_agreement_no, a.category, a.vendor_id, MAX(a.lead_time_weeks) AS lead_time_weeks
FROM commitments.framework_agreement a
GROUP BY a.framework_agreement_no, a.category, a.vendor_id

graph_hero_questions.text: Which contracts have grown most since award?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.contract at high confidence (0.94).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c.contract_no, c.project_code, c.award_value_usd, c.current_value_usd, (c.current_value_usd - c.award_value_usd) / NULLIF(c.award_value_usd, 0) AS growth
FROM pmo.contract c

graph_hero_questions.text: How long do WIN budget revisions take to approve at each level?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.win_authorization at high confidence (0.95).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT w.approval_level, AVG(DATEDIFF(day, w.requested_on, w.approved_on)) AS avg_days
FROM commitments.win_authorization w
WHERE w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.approved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY w.approval_level

graph_hero_questions.text: Which projects' in-service dates have slipped since approval, and by how long?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.project + upload.inservice at medium confidence (0.82): 990 projects have no in-service row.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, p.planned_in_service_date, i.forecast_in_service_date,
       DATEDIFF(day, p.planned_in_service_date, i.forecast_in_service_date) AS slip_days
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = p.project_code
WHERE i.forecast_in_service_date > p.planned_in_service_date

graph_hero_questions.text: Which open commitments have had no receipt for more than 90 days?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across commitments.po_line at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT l.project_code, l.po_number, l.line_no, l.ordered_on, l.ordered_usd - l.received_usd - l.cancelled_usd AS open_usd
FROM commitments.po_line l
WHERE l.line_status = 'Open' AND l.ordered_on < DATEADD(day, -90, '2026-10-19')

graph_hero_questions.text: Is the PFAS program spending to plan in each utility?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across gl.project_costing_line + pmo.project at high confidence (0.9).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, SUM(g.amount_usd) AS posted_usd
FROM gl.project_costing_line g
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = g.project_code
WHERE p.compliance_driver = 'PFAS rule' AND g.fiscal_period LIKE '2026-%'
GROUP BY p.utility_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Which forecasts moved most since last month, and why?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.forecast + mailbox at question time at medium confidence (0.84).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_date, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         LAG(forecast_at_completion_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date) AS previous_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT project_code, forecast_date, previous_usd, forecast_at_completion_usd, forecast_at_completion_usd - previous_usd AS moved_usd
FROM f WHERE rn = 1 AND previous_usd IS NOT NULL

graph_hero_questions.text: Where does my project stand: approved, committed, forecast and contingency left?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + epbcs.forecast + commitments.po_line at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT f.project_code, f.forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.project_code ORDER BY f.forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast f
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd AS variance_usd,
       (l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd) / NULLIF(b.approved_budget_usd, 0) AS variance_pct
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.phase <> 'Closed'

graph_hero_questions.text: How much AFUDC have we accrued this year, by project?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.cwip_balance at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT c.project_code, c.afudc_ytd_usd
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09' AND c.afudc_ytd_usd > 0

graph_hero_questions.text: How much CWIP sits outside rate base in each utility?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.cwip_balance + pmo.project at high confidence (0.93).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, c.project_code, c.cwip_usd
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = c.project_code
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09' AND c.cwip_usd > 0

graph_hero_questions.text: What plant did each region place in service this year?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across assets.plant_in_service at high confidence (0.92).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.plant_class, s.project_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS added_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.in_service_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.plant_class, s.project_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Does the five-year plan stay inside each utility's envelope?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + pmo.project at high confidence (0.88).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT b.plan_vintage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.compliance_driver <> 'None' THEN b.plan_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(b.plan_amount_usd) AS mandated_share
FROM epbcs.plan b
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = b.project_code
WHERE b.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2027 AND 2031
GROUP BY b.plan_vintage

graph_hero_questions.text: Which unfunded high-risk renewals would we fund first, and what would they cost?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.project (priority, risk) + epbcs.plan at medium confidence (0.78): risk is rated per project, not per asset.
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, p.priority_level, b.plan_amount_usd
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'MTP'
WHERE p.priority_level = 1 AND b.approved_budget_usd = 0
ORDER BY b.plan_amount_usd DESC

graph_hero_questions.text: How much eligible spend can we draw from SRF and WIFIA loans this month?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across gl.project_costing_line + the funding tracker documents at medium confidence (0.76).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, SUM(g.amount_usd) AS eligible_spend_usd
FROM gl.project_costing_line g
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = g.project_code
WHERE p.compliance_driver IN ('PFAS rule', 'Lead and Copper Rule Improvements') AND g.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY p.utility_code

graph_hero_questions.text: What will the program add to rate base across the four utilities next year?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across epbcs.plan + upload.inservice + assets.plant_in_service at medium confidence (0.8).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.plant_class, s.project_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS added_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.in_service_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.plant_class, s.project_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Which data requests on the rate base are still open, and what evidence answers them?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across the rate case documents + mailbox at question time at medium confidence (0.77).

graph_hero_questions.text: How many approved projects have no project manager assigned?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Resolves across pmo.project at high confidence (0.96).
graph_hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, COUNT(*) AS projects_without_pm
FROM pmo.project p
WHERE p.phase IN ('In Development', 'In Delivery') AND p.project_manager IS NULL
GROUP BY p.utility_code

graph_hero_questions.text: Predict which mains will fail next year.
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Declined: the GIS asset layer and break history are not connected, so failure cannot be predicted.

cip: Collect project requests from engineering and operations

reg: Prepare capital schedules and rate base additions for rate cases

Report to lenders and funding agencies

Answer ad hoc questions from leadership

graph_use_case_templates.name: Capital Program Analyst
graph_use_case_templates.description: One graph over plan, forecast, ledger, commitments, approvals, contracts and rate case claims, so a capital question resolves once and states which vintage and which forecast it read.

graph_metrics.name: Forecast variance
graph_metrics.definition: Forecast at completion minus approved budget, per project, from the latest working forecast. Positive means overrun; a large project above 10% needs a WIN budget revision.
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT f.project_code, f.forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.project_code ORDER BY f.forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast f
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd AS variance_usd,
       (l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd) / NULLIF(b.approved_budget_usd, 0) AS variance_pct
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.phase <> 'Closed'

graph_metrics.name: Large projects above 10%
graph_metrics.definition: Large projects in delivery whose forecast at completion is more than 10% above the approved budget, with whether a WIN budget revision is raised.
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commitments.win_authorization w
                         WHERE w.project_code = p.project_code AND w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.win_status = 'Pending')
            THEN 'Revision raised' ELSE 'No revision' END AS win_state
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.large_project = 1 AND p.phase = 'In Delivery'
  AND l.forecast_at_completion_usd > 1.10 * b.approved_budget_usd

graph_metrics.name: Spend vs plan, year to date
graph_metrics.definition: Posted actuals in the fiscal year to date divided by the calendarized plan for the same months.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(g.amount_usd) AS posted_ytd_usd,
       (SELECT SUM(m.plan_usd) FROM epbcs.monthly_spread m
        WHERE m.fiscal_year = 2026 AND m.vintage = 'Jan Calendarization' AND m.period <= 9) AS plan_ytd_usd
FROM gl.project_costing_line g
WHERE g.fiscal_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-09'

graph_metrics.name: Annual plan delivery
graph_metrics.definition: Posted to date plus the working forecast to year end, divided by the annual plan. Below 95% means capital moves into next year.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.period <= 9 THEN g.posted_usd ELSE m.forecast_usd END) AS expected_fy_usd,
       SUM(m.plan_usd) AS plan_fy_usd
FROM epbcs.monthly_spread m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_code, CAST(RIGHT(fiscal_period, 2) AS INT) AS period, SUM(amount_usd) AS posted_usd
           FROM gl.project_costing_line WHERE fiscal_period LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY project_code, RIGHT(fiscal_period, 2)) g
  ON g.project_code = m.project_code AND g.period = m.period
WHERE m.fiscal_year = 2026 AND m.vintage = 'Working'

graph_metrics.name: Forecast freshness
graph_metrics.definition: Active projects whose latest working forecast is older than 45 days, by region and cost tool.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.region, p.cost_tool, COUNT(*) AS stale_projects, SUM(b.approved_budget_usd) AS budget_usd
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
WHERE p.phase IN ('In Development', 'In Delivery')
  AND (SELECT MAX(f.forecast_date) FROM epbcs.forecast f WHERE f.project_code = p.project_code) < DATEADD(day, -45, '2026-10-15')
GROUP BY p.region, p.cost_tool

graph_metrics.name: Open commitments
graph_metrics.definition: Ordered minus received minus cancelled, on open PO lines. Unpaid invoices are not open commitment.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT l.project_code, SUM(l.ordered_usd - l.received_usd - l.cancelled_usd) AS open_usd
FROM commitments.po_line l
WHERE l.line_status = 'Open'
GROUP BY l.project_code

graph_metrics.name: Change order rate
graph_metrics.definition: Approved change orders divided by original contract value, per contract and project.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c.project_code, c.contract_no, c.award_value_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.co_status = 'Approved' THEN o.cost_impact_usd ELSE 0 END) AS approved_co_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.co_status = 'Approved' THEN o.cost_impact_usd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(c.award_value_usd, 0) AS co_rate
FROM pmo.contract c
LEFT JOIN pmo.change_order o ON o.contract_no = c.contract_no
GROUP BY c.project_code, c.contract_no, c.award_value_usd

graph_metrics.name: Contingency remaining
graph_metrics.definition: Contingency still held in the latest forecast divided by contingency at authorization.
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, contingency_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT b.project_code, b.contingency_usd AS contingency_at_approval_usd, l.contingency_usd AS contingency_left_usd
FROM epbcs.plan b
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = b.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026

graph_metrics.name: Budget revisions waiting
graph_metrics.definition: WIN budget revisions requested and not yet approved, by approval level and age.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT w.approval_level, COUNT(*) AS pending, SUM(w.amount_usd) AS amount_usd,
       MAX(DATEDIFF(day, w.requested_on, '2026-10-19')) AS oldest_days
FROM commitments.win_authorization w
WHERE w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.win_status = 'Pending'
GROUP BY w.approval_level

graph_metrics.name: Test-year in-service at risk
graph_metrics.definition: Projects claimed in service inside a test year whose expected in-service date is now after the test year ends, with the rate base at stake.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT r.docket, r.project_code, p.project_name, r.claimed_in_service_by, i.forecast_in_service_date, r.rate_base_usd
FROM pmo.rate_case_claim r
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = r.project_code
LEFT JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = r.project_code
WHERE r.claim_status IN ('Claimed', 'Updated')
  AND (i.forecast_in_service_date > r.test_year_end OR i.project_code IS NULL)

graph_metrics.name: Plant additions vs rate order
graph_metrics.definition: Plant placed in service in the period divided by the capital additions the last order assumed.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS placed_in_service_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = s.project_code
WHERE s.in_service_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.utility_code

graph_metrics.name: In service, still in CWIP
graph_metrics.definition: Projects past their in-service date that still carry an open CWIP balance.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c.project_code, c.cwip_usd, i.forecast_in_service_date
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = c.project_code
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09' AND c.cwip_usd > 0 AND i.forecast_in_service_date < '2026-08-01'

graph_metrics.name: Program health
graph_metrics.definition: Large projects in delivery within 10% of approved budget divided by all large projects in delivery.
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.forecast_at_completion_usd <= 1.10 * b.approved_budget_usd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS health
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.large_project = 1 AND p.phase = 'In Delivery'

graph_metrics.name: Mandated share of the plan
graph_metrics.definition: Planned spend on projects with a compliance driver divided by total planned spend, by vintage.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT b.plan_vintage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.compliance_driver <> 'None' THEN b.plan_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(b.plan_amount_usd) AS mandated_share
FROM epbcs.plan b
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = b.project_code
WHERE b.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2027 AND 2031
GROUP BY b.plan_vintage

graph_metrics.name: Net plant in service
graph_metrics.definition: Utility plant in service less accumulated depreciation, by plant class and utility, at a period end.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.plant_class, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS gross_plant_usd, SUM(d.accumulated_depreciation_usd) AS accumulated_depreciation_usd,
       SUM(s.amount_usd) - SUM(d.accumulated_depreciation_usd) AS net_plant_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
JOIN assets.depreciation_reserve d ON d.asset_id = s.asset_id AND d.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
WHERE s.retired_on IS NULL
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.plant_class

graph_metrics.name: Rate base
graph_metrics.definition: Net plant in service less contributions in aid of construction, accumulated deferred income taxes and customer advances, plus cash working capital and materials and supplies. CWIP is excluded.
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT s.utility_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) - SUM(d.accumulated_depreciation_usd) AS net_plant_usd
  FROM assets.plant_in_service s
  JOIN assets.depreciation_reserve d ON d.asset_id = s.asset_id AND d.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
  WHERE s.retired_on IS NULL GROUP BY s.utility_code
)
SELECT p.utility_code, p.net_plant_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.treatment = 'Deduct' THEN -c.amount_usd ELSE c.amount_usd END) AS adjustments_usd,
       p.net_plant_usd + SUM(CASE WHEN c.treatment = 'Deduct' THEN -c.amount_usd ELSE c.amount_usd END) AS rate_base_usd
FROM plant p
JOIN assets.rate_base_component c ON c.utility_code = p.utility_code AND c.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY p.utility_code, p.net_plant_usd

graph_metrics.name: Rate base change since the last order
graph_metrics.definition: Rate base now against the rate base the last order allowed, with the plant additions that explain the change.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS additions_since_order_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.in_service_date > '2022-12-31' AND s.retired_on IS NULL
GROUP BY s.utility_code

graph_metrics.name: Plant additions in the period
graph_metrics.definition: Cost placed in service in the period, by utility, plant class and project.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.plant_class, s.project_code, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS added_usd
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.in_service_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.plant_class, s.project_code

graph_metrics.name: CWIP balance
graph_metrics.definition: Open construction work in progress at period end, by utility and project, excluded from rate base.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, c.project_code, c.cwip_usd
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = c.project_code
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09' AND c.cwip_usd > 0

graph_metrics.name: CWIP aging
graph_metrics.definition: CWIP balance by months since the first charge; balances older than 24 months are reviewed.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 24 THEN 'Over 24 months' WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 12 THEN '12 to 24 months' ELSE 'Under 12 months' END AS age_band,
       SUM(c.cwip_usd) AS cwip_usd
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 24 THEN 'Over 24 months' WHEN DATEDIFF(month, c.first_charge_date, '2026-09-30') > 12 THEN '12 to 24 months' ELSE 'Under 12 months' END

graph_metrics.name: AFUDC accrued
graph_metrics.definition: AFUDC posted in the fiscal year to date, by project.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c.project_code, c.afudc_ytd_usd
FROM assets.cwip_balance c
WHERE c.fiscal_period = '2026-09' AND c.afudc_ytd_usd > 0

graph_metrics.name: Depreciation expense
graph_metrics.definition: Depreciation booked in the period, by plant class, at the rates the last order approved.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT d.plant_class, d.depreciation_rate, SUM(d.depreciation_expense_usd) AS expense_usd
FROM assets.depreciation_reserve d
WHERE d.fiscal_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-09'
GROUP BY d.plant_class, d.depreciation_rate

graph_metrics.name: In service, not yet unitized
graph_metrics.definition: Assets placed in service whose cost Plant Accounting has not yet unitized, by project and age.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.utility_code, s.project_code, COUNT(*) AS assets, SUM(s.amount_usd) AS amount_usd, MIN(s.in_service_date) AS earliest_in_service
FROM assets.plant_in_service s
WHERE s.unitized = 0
GROUP BY s.utility_code, s.project_code

graph_metrics.name: Framework compliance
graph_metrics.definition: Spend on catalogue items ordered under a framework agreement divided by all spend on items a framework covers.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT a.category,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.framework_agreement_no IS NOT NULL THEN l.ordered_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.ordered_usd) AS framework_share
FROM commitments.po_line l
JOIN commitments.framework_agreement a ON a.item_code = l.item_code
WHERE l.ordered_on >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY a.category

graph_metrics.name: Off-framework price premium
graph_metrics.definition: What off-framework order lines cost above the framework price for the same item: (unit price minus framework price) times quantity.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT l.po_number, l.line_no, l.project_code, l.item_code, l.quantity, l.unit_price_usd, a.framework_unit_price_usd,
       (l.unit_price_usd - a.framework_unit_price_usd) * l.quantity AS premium_usd, l.confirmation_status
FROM commitments.po_line l
JOIN commitments.framework_agreement a ON a.item_code = l.item_code
WHERE l.framework_agreement_no IS NULL AND l.unit_price_usd > a.framework_unit_price_usd

graph_metrics.name: Savings secured against target
graph_metrics.definition: Savings secured since 1 July 2026 against the target of 2.5% of addressable capital procurement spend.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT s.lever, SUM(s.savings_usd) AS secured_usd
FROM commitments.savings_register s
WHERE s.secured_on >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY s.lever

graph_metrics.name: Framework supplier lead time
graph_metrics.definition: Lead time each framework supplier currently confirms, by category.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT a.framework_agreement_no, a.category, a.vendor_id, MAX(a.lead_time_weeks) AS lead_time_weeks
FROM commitments.framework_agreement a
GROUP BY a.framework_agreement_no, a.category, a.vendor_id

graph_metrics.name: Contract growth since award
graph_metrics.definition: Current contract value against value at award, per contract.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT c.contract_no, c.project_code, c.award_value_usd, c.current_value_usd, (c.current_value_usd - c.award_value_usd) / NULLIF(c.award_value_usd, 0) AS growth
FROM pmo.contract c

graph_metrics.name: Budget revision cycle time
graph_metrics.definition: Days from a WIN budget revision request to its approval, by approval level.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT w.approval_level, AVG(DATEDIFF(day, w.requested_on, w.approved_on)) AS avg_days
FROM commitments.win_authorization w
WHERE w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.approved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY w.approval_level

graph_metrics.name: In-service date slippage
graph_metrics.definition: Expected in-service date against the date at approval, per project.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, p.planned_in_service_date, i.forecast_in_service_date,
       DATEDIFF(day, p.planned_in_service_date, i.forecast_in_service_date) AS slip_days
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = p.project_code
WHERE i.forecast_in_service_date > p.planned_in_service_date

graph_metrics.name: Aged open commitments
graph_metrics.definition: Open order lines with no receipt for more than 90 days.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT l.project_code, l.po_number, l.line_no, l.ordered_on, l.ordered_usd - l.received_usd - l.cancelled_usd AS open_usd
FROM commitments.po_line l
WHERE l.line_status = 'Open' AND l.ordered_on < DATEADD(day, -90, '2026-10-19')

graph_metrics.name: PFAS program spend against plan
graph_metrics.definition: Posted spend on PFAS projects against the FY26 plan for them.
graph_metrics.sql:
SELECT p.utility_code, SUM(g.amount_usd) AS posted_usd
FROM gl.project_costing_line g
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = g.project_code
WHERE p.compliance_driver = 'PFAS rule' AND g.fiscal_period LIKE '2026-%'
GROUP BY p.utility_code

graph_metrics.name: Forecast movement since last month
graph_metrics.definition: Change in forecast at completion between the last two working forecasts, per project.
graph_metrics.sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_date, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         LAG(forecast_at_completion_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date) AS previous_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT project_code, forecast_date, previous_usd, forecast_at_completion_usd, forecast_at_completion_usd - previous_usd AS moved_usd
FROM f WHERE rn = 1 AND previous_usd IS NOT NULL
